hpo_source.rule: aspect P, qualifier != NOT, deduplicate in file order
hpo_source.scope: disease-level annotation, not a FANCA-specific patient or subtype

mechanism.class: biallelic loss-of-function hypothesis; no individual variants asserted
mechanism.pathway: FA core complex / DNA interstrand cross-link repair
mechanism.distinction: MVA: BUB1B spindle checkpoint; Bloom: BLM homologous recombination

limitations: Bounded null: 100 draws vs 1000 historically; no calibration panel rerun.
No patient genome or pharmacogenomics; no clinical interpretation.
Not run: PRISM, LINCS, approval labels, intervention curation, convergence, K1/K2/K3.
